request.description:
Update lead currently is a PUT request and It is a 3 step process for now

  1. Fetch lead details using 'Get lead details' API.
  2. From above request's response, update those fields which you want.
  3. Copy paste the new payload in Update lead request's body and hit 'Send' request.

API KEY can be found here

Find Ids as below:

  • For pipeline id and stage ids visit here
  • For any form field details like picklist value ids, Company type ids, Campaign, Source, any Custom fields and their value ids visit here
  • For product details and its ids visit here

For all the above types other than connected, remove 'duration' key

{
    "outcome": "connected",

    "notes": [
        {

        },

            "description": "Test note 2"
        }

    "relatedTo": {
        "id": 297573,

    "callRecording": {

request.description:
Put the below code in Pre-requisite script to import data from csv file

var payload = {};

//company name
if (data["name"] != "") {
    payload["name"] = data["name"];
}

// city
if (data["city"] != "") {
    payload["city"] = data["city"];
}

// state
if (data["state"] != "") {
    payload["state"] = data["state"];
}

//address
if (data["address"] != "") {
    payload["address"] = data["address"];
}

// zipcode
if (data["zipcode"] != "") {
    payload["zipcode"] = data["zipcode"];
}


// phone numbers | if there are multiple phone numbers | rename columns as 'phone1', 'phone2' and 'phone3'

if (data["phone1"] != "") {
    // for number 1
    var phone1 = data["phone1"];
    var phone1_obj = {
        "type": "MOBILE",
        "dialCode": "+91",
        "code": "IN",
        "value": phone1,
        "primary": true
    }

    payload["phoneNumbers"] = [];
    payload["phoneNumbers"].push(phone1_obj);

    if (data["phone2"] != "") {

        var phone2 = data["phone2"];
        var phone2_obj = {
            "type": "MOBILE",
            "dialCode": "+91",
            "code": "IN",
            "value": phone2,
            "primary": false
        }
        payload["phoneNumbers"].push(phone2_obj);

        if (data["phone3"] != "") {

            var phone3 = data["phone3"];
            var phone3_obj = {
                "type": "MOBILE",
                "dialCode": "+91",
                "code": "IN",
                "value": phone3,
                "primary": false
            }
            payload["phoneNumbers"].push(phone3_obj);
        }

    }

}


// custom field values

var customFieldValuesPayload = {};

// discount | Custom text field
if (data["discount"] != "") {
    customFieldValuesPayload["cfDiscount"] = data["discount"] + " ";
}

// policystatus | Custom picklist | Enter custom field values as IDs
var policyStatus = {};

if (data["policy"] != "") {
    policyStatus["id"] = data["policy"];
    policyStatus["name"] = data["<picklist_value_name>"];
}


payload["customFieldValues"] = customFieldValuesPayload;

console.log(payload);
pm.globals.set('body', JSON.stringify(payload));

var payload = {};

//first name | Contact first name | Rename the column in sheet as 'Name'
if (data["Name"] != "") {
    payload["firstName"] = data["Name"];
}

//last name | Contact last name | Rename the column in sheet as 'surname'
if (data["surname"] != "") {
    payload["lastName"] = data["surname"];
}

// email | enter email column in sheet as 'email'
if (data["email"] != "") {
    var emailId = data["email"];
    var email = {
        "type": "OFFICE",
        "value": emailId,
        "primary": true
    }
    payload["emails"] = [];
    payload["emails"].push(email);
}

// phone numbers | if there are multiple phone numbers | rename columns as 'phone1', 'phone2' and 'phone3'

if (data["phone1"] != "") {

    var phone1_obj = {
        "type": "MOBILE",
        "dialCode": "+91",
        "code": "IN",
        "value": phone1,
        "primary": true
    }

    payload["phoneNumbers"] = [];
    payload["phoneNumbers"].push(phone1_obj);

    if (data["phone2"] != "") {
        var phone2 = data["phone2"];
        var phone2_obj = {
            "type": "MOBILE",
            "dialCode": "+91",
            "code": "IN",
            "value": phone2,
            "primary": false
        }
        payload["phoneNumbers"].push(phone2_obj);

        if (data["phone3"] != "") {
            var phone3 = data["phone3"];
            var phone3_obj = {
                "type": "MOBILE",
                "dialCode": "+91",
                "code": "IN",
                "value": phone3,
                "primary": false
            }
            payload["phoneNumbers"].push(phone3_obj);
        }
    }
}



// address | Rename the address column in sheet as 'address'
if (data["address"] != "") {
    payload["address"] = data["address"];
}

//City
if (data["city"] != "") {
    payload["city"] = data["city"];
}

// state
if (data["state"] != "") {
    payload["state"] = data["state"];
}

// zipcode
if (data["zipcode"] != "") {
    payload["zipcode"] = data["zipcode"];
}

// company | enter the company id | Rename the column in sheet as 'company_id'
if (data["company"] != "") {
    payload["company"] = data["company_id"];
}

// country
if (data["country_id"] == "India") {
    payload["country"] = "IN";
}

// designation | enter designation | Rename the column in sheet as 'designation'
if (data["designation"] != "") {
    payload["designation"] = data["designation"];
}


// Custom fields section

var customFieldValuesPayload = {};

// product or services
if (data["id"] != "") {
    customFieldValuesPayload["productsOrServices"] = data["id"];
}

// Custom text field 
if (data["custom_field"] != "") {
    customFieldValuesPayload["cfCustomTextField"] = data["custom_field"];
}

// Custom picklist | Picklist values to be entered in the sheet
if (data["custom_picklist_field"] != "") {
    customFieldValuesPayload["dumyPicklist"] = data["custom_picklist_field"];
}

console.log(payload);
pm.globals.set('body', JSON.stringify(payload));
